title: Stone Game VII
description: Alice and Bob play a game with a row of stones. Alice removes a stone from either end. The player who removes the stones gains points equal to the sum of remaining stones. Maximize Alice's score difference.
pseudocode:
1. n = stones.length
2. dp[i][j] = max(sum(i+1, j) - dp[i+1][j], sum(i, j-1) - dp[i][j-1])
3. return dp[0][n-1]

steps.note: Initialize DP table for stones [5, 3, 1]. n = 3.
Base case: length 1 intervals [i, i] are 0 score.
Calculate dp[0][1] (stones [5, 3]): Alice takes 5 (sum 3) or 3 (sum 5). Max is 3.
Calculate dp[1][2] (stones [3, 1]): Alice takes 3 (sum 1) or 1 (sum 3). Max is 1.
Calculate dp[0][2] (stones [5, 3, 1]): Alice takes 5 (sum 4 - dp[1][2]=1 = 3) or 1 (sum 8 - dp[0][1]=3 = 5). Max is 5.
Final result for game is dp[0][2] = 5.
